title: 十年新秀：上市首日飙升446%，后续走势能否持续？
speaker: MS Huahong

segments.en: MS is great to have you here, especially on such a really milestone day for CMT.
segments.zh: 很高兴您能来，尤其是在CMT这个里程碑式的日子。

segments.en: I mean, 400% gains in north of that. How do you feel like this is going to look like for the rest of the week, and maybe in the perceived future months here now?
segments.zh: 涨幅超过400%。您认为本周乃至未来几个月市场会如何表现？

segments.en: Hi, good morning, thanks for having me. It's an incredible moment that only 10-year-old baby in memory semi-conductor manufacturing industry is getting listed.
segments.zh: 早上好，感谢邀请。这是一个不可思议的时刻，一家仅成立十年的存储半导体制造企业成功上市。

segments.en: And initial trading price, 446% upside, that's incredible.
This company has been catching up the peer groups, but I believe that these share excitement is reflecting the upside potential.
segments.zh: 这家公司一直在追赶同行，我认为股价的兴奋反映了其上涨潜力。
